tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who Must have manufactured tested and Supplied the equipment similar to the type Specified in the Schedule Requirements SUPPLY of 2 Auto Tippers of minimum 3cum Work Done Certificates. for NON Micro and small Enterprises in any one of the last 3 Years from 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 it will be 01 Auto Tippers of minimum 3cum Work Done Certificates. with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises of the quantity required in any one of the last 2 Years (2024-25 & 2025-26) The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design
Tenderer should submit company registration certificate and should hold the renewed valid license should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Tenderer should submit company registration certificate and should hold the renewed valid license should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be not less than Rs 26.50 Lakhs during the last 3 preceding financial years. lt will be Rs 13.25 Lakhs with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises during the last 2 preceding financial years ending on the relevant financial Years. (CA Certified Copy with Balance Sheets with UDIN Number of Last Three Years Turnover details)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a manufacturer, meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided a. the manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC and b. the tenderer, as authorized representative, has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 02 Nos Auto Tippers of minimum 3cum of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Specifications of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least 18 months on the date of tender opening

The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit on Rs.100 stamp paper stating that the bidder has not been blacklisted, banned, or debarred by any Government Department, ULB, PSU, Board, Corporation, or Government Agency during the last five 05 years and that no criminal case involving fraud, corruption, or misappropriation is pending against the bidder.

The bidder shall have a functional service center within the State of Karnataka for timely support, maintenance, and emergency service assistance. Documentary proof of service center establishment shall be submitted along with the bid.
